mapper.update: WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT credential.id FROM iam_credential credential JOIN iam_passkey passkey ON passkey.credential_id = credential.id JOIN iam_account account ON account.id = credential.account_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_subject subject ON subject.id = account.subject_id AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.deleted = 0 WHERE credential.id = #{credentialId} AND credential.account_id = #{accountId} AND credential.credential_type = 'PASSKEY' AND credential.status = 'ACTIVE' AND credential.version = #{version} AND credential.deleted = 0 AND passkey.signature_count = #{expectedSignatureCount} AND passkey.backup_eligible = #{backupEligible} FOR UPDATE ), updated_passkey AS ( UPDATE iam_passkey SET signature_count = #{signatureCount}, backup_state = #{backupState}, last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE credential_id IN (SELECT id FROM target) RETURNING credential_id ) UPDATE iam_credential SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT credential_id FROM updated_passkey)
